notes.title: InnerSpace Free Content Update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11792196/e17069fd50586ca0abb04e09409f6fd78f5dc69a.jpg
Salutations explorers!

InnerSpace has been live for almost three months now, and we’ve been listening closely to our players and to critic reviews. As a small team of just seven developers, we are always trying to learn and improve, so we’re super excited to deliver our free content update. This update addresses a lot of critical feedback, offers new airframes for new playstyles, and adds customizations designed by our very own Kickstarter backers!

Without further ado, here are our two new airframes, the Hopper and Glass Piano.

Hopper: A craft for slow contemplation and observation. This airframe stops completely when drifting, allowing players to look around without fear of crashing. It also sports a nifty compass that always points towards the world’s center, which is the closest thing the Inverse has to “North.”

Glass Piano: A fragile variant of the piano airframe. A lot of players came away with the impression that you can’t die in InnerSpace. Technically this isn’t true, and we wanted to give intrepid pilots the chance to make their own legend. This airframe shares most stats with the regular Piano but is much easier to break. This is our way of adding HARD MODE. Good luck!

Full update notes below. And remember, your greatest journey is within!

Airframes:
Added unlockable airframe skins! Visit the Archaeologist to unlock new colors for all of your airframes.
Added 2 new relics: Hopper Wing (Sunchamber) and Glass Wing (Dawnvessel).
Added 2 new planes: Hopper and Glass Piano. Hopper can stop completely when drifting, whereas Glass Piano is a fragile, challenge-mode plane.
Woodwind airframe has a much slower brake speed, so learning the game is easier for new players in the tutorial.
Zephyr Spark airframe drift/airbrake is slower and has faster turning speeds.

Game-Wide Improvements:
Revised Archaeologist dialogue for Sunchamber discussions, especially if you're looking for help or hints.
Added an inspector pillar for the statue in Mornsea.
Added an inspector pillar for new statues in the Eventide.
Respawning rope interactions change color if they’ve been cut before. 
Added a relic-counter to pause menu.
Invert button on start-screen fixed.
Various minor bug fixes. 

P.S. For those of you interested in a photo-mode, combine the Hopper airframe with the invisible skin to get wide-angle stills!

notes.title: Patch 1: Feb 5, 2018
notes.content:
Explorers!

Our first update to InnerSpace has just flipped live. Hop back in and let us know your thoughts! Don't forget to leave us a Steam review too.

Full patch notes below.

Additions

Added two interactions with Sun in Sunchamber: large Wind globule added after first collision & the sun regenerates to full brightness over time
Added additional wind to the Sunchamber and Eventide to improve signposting
Added baby sunfish to the Dawnvessel
Added scenic shots to the Archaeologist's opening dialogue in the Sunchamber

Fixes

Fixed a bug where Duskprism boss would be invisible for multiple cutscenes 
Small tweaks to improve visibility in low-light scenarios 
Fixed a bug where players weren’t able to view the world-scale holograms in Eventide. 
Various bug fixes
Various performance improvements

Tuning

Grouped towers leading to other worlds in Sunchamber by color
Improved signposting in Sunchamber cutscenes
Removed redundant lines of dialogue in Archaeologist interactions
Improvements to the Sunfish encounter
Updated some plane models to better show when Drift is active 
Updated credits

notes.title: InnerSpace takes flight on January 16th!
notes.content:
http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11792196/5f30cc6271e4f05ee6b73cd027c439d551d69df8.gif

Welcome Explorers!

Your long wait to begin your flight is coming to an end. We’re launching on January 16th! Check out our new trailer!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PFrs_wHT1z8

To celebrate, we’re doing a fun community giveaway leading up to launch. We started on Kickstarter, using goals to drive up funds. This time around, we’re using goals to drive up followers on Steam!

Click that Follow Button (the Follow Button is located right beneath the trailer), for a chance to win limited run airframes.! Take a look:

http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11792196/0b489feac074f3f2e06bce91e978bf703d4dbd21.jpg

Oh, and you’ll also get a copy of InnerSpace :)

Random followers of the InnerSpace Steam page will be selected as we reach the goals listed below. So what are the goals? See our initial goals below, and note that stretch goals (and surprises) can always be added!

1,000 - 1 airframe
2,500 - 1 more airframe
5,000- 1 more airframe
7,500 - 1 more airframe
10,000- 5  more airframes

Our first goal was hit prior to this announcement, so congratulations to our first winner: 

Virlomi

Tl;dr
If you follow the InnerSpace Steam Page, you’re eligible for the giveaway!

Next goal is less than 1,000 followers away. Let’s get it!

You can view our number of followers  HERE.
